info.name: Assignment 3 - Question Bank
info.description: Assignment 3 requests use full URLs (no collection variables). Replace PASTE_* placeholders with tokens or IDs from earlier responses. Register ordinary users, promote the designated admin account in MongoDB (admin=true), then log in as Admin. Run denial checks before final delete requests.

item.name: 01 - Xác thực
item.description: Create normal users and store bearer tokens. Admin login requires a user already promoted to admin=true in MongoDB.
